_comment: User-facing strings for Liar's Dice. Bracketed action tokens ('[Bid: X, Y]', '[Call]'), player ids, dice face values, quantities and counts are neutral slots and must never be translated.

_slots.num_players: number of players in the game (integer)
_slots.your_dice: pre-rendered comma-joined list of this player's dice face values
_slots.d: remaining dice count for that player (integer)
_slots.loser_id: player index who loses a die (integer)
_slots.action: the raw action string the player submitted
_slots.final_ranking: list of player indices from first eliminated to winner

player_prompt.intro:
Ko koe te Kaitakaro {player_id} i tetahi taonga {num_players}-kaitakaro o te keemu Liar's Dice.
Ture:
- I runga i to wā, ka taea e koe te mahi i tetahi o enei:
  1) Mahi i tetahi tāpae hou me te nui ake o te tatau ranei te kanohi (ko te rua), ko '[Bid: 3, 4]',
  2) Karanga te tāpae whakamutunga e tuhituhi '[Call]'.

Ki te karanga koe:
  - Ki te tatau tūturu o taua uara kanohi i waenganui i nga kōwhatu katoa he iti i te tāpae, ka potea te kaitāpae whakamutunga kotahi kōwhatu.
  - Waimarie, ka potea te karanga kotahi kōwhatu.
He kaitakaro ka taea te 0 kōwhatu ka whakakorea atu. Ko te kaitakaro whakamutunga ka wini.

board.new_round:
Raunou hou - Tūāhuhi kōwhatu: {dice_summary}
Ōu kōwhatu o nāianei ko: {your_dice}

call.bidder_loses:
Kaitakaro {current_player_id} ka karanga! Ko te tatau tūturu o te kanohi {face_value} ko {count}, koia ko te iti i {quantity}.
Kaitakaro {loser_id} (te kaitāpae whakamutunga) ka potea kotahi kōwhatu.
call.caller_loses:
Kaitakaro {current_player_id} ka karanga! Ko te tatau tūturu o te kanohi {face_value} ko {count}, koia ko te nui ake ranei {quantity}.
Kaitakaro {loser_id} (te kaitāpae) ka potea kotahi kōwhatu.

invalid_move.call_no_bid: I waea atu me te kore tono i mua.
invalid_move.not_recognized: Mahi kāore i te mohiotia ko te '[Bid: X, Y]' whai take ranei '[Call]'. Mahi i tukua: {action}

bid_reason.quantity_lower: Ko te rahinga hou {new_quantity} he iti ake i te o nāianei {current_quantity}.
bid_reason.face_lower: Ko te uara ingoa hou {new_face_value} he iti ake i te o nāianei {current_face_value}.
bid_reason.identical: He ōrite te tono ki te tuku o nāianei.
bid_reason.face_range: Me waiho te uara mata i waenganui 1 me 6.

message.eliminated_invalid: Player {player_id} was eliminated by invalid move.
